name: Coffin Dance
look: A low-resolution video still of pallbearers in black suits, white shirts, white gloves and top hats with white bands, wearing sunglasses as they carry an ornate wooden coffin on their shoulders and dance through a crowded outdoor procession.
use: A dark punchline for risky or foolish choices. The setup describes someone about to do something dangerous or dumb, and the dancing pallbearers imply they will soon be needed.
slots: top caption: the risky or foolish thing someone is about to do
examples: Me telling my mom I'm too old for a curfew
Saying "what could go wrong?" before a skateboard trick
describe: men in suits dancing while carrying a coffin
pallbearers in top hats and sunglasses dancing at a funeral

origin: Footage of a team of professional pallbearers in Ghana who dance while carrying coffins; it spread worldwide as a meme in 2020.
